title: Customer focus
requirement: Product and service conformity and on-time delivery performance measured and acted on

title: Management representative
requirement: A management representative appointed with authority over the QMS

title: Measurement traceability
requirement: Register of monitoring and measuring equipment with calibration method, frequency and acceptance; recall process

title: Competence
requirement: Competence including product safety and human factors where relevant

title: Awareness
requirement: Awareness of contribution to product conformity, product safety and ethical behaviour

title: QMS documentation
requirement: Documented information describing interested parties, scope, processes and their interaction, responsibilities

title: Data protection
requirement: Protect documented information from loss, unauthorized changes, corruption; control of data

title: Operational planning
requirement: Plan for personal and product safety, producibility, inspectability, reliability, maintainability; key characteristics; work transfer control

title: Operational risk management
requirement: Process to identify, assess, mitigate, accept and communicate operational risks

title: Configuration management
requirement: Process for configuration identification, change control, status accounting and audits

title: Product safety
requirement: Process to assure product safety across the life cycle: hazards, critical items, reporting of events

title: Prevention of counterfeit parts
requirement: Process for counterfeit-part prevention: training, sourcing from OEM/authorized channels, verification, reporting, quarantine

title: Special requirements and critical items
requirement: Identify special requirements, critical items and key characteristics in requirements review

title: Review of requirements
requirement: Review includes special requirements and risks; coordinate with customer on unresolved items

title: Verification and validation testing
requirement: Test plans, specifications and acceptance criteria for design verification and validation

title: Design outputs
requirement: Outputs specify key characteristics, critical items and data to produce, inspect, install and maintain

title: External providers
requirement: Register of external providers with approval status and scope; periodic performance review (conformity, OTD); customer-designated sources

title: Verification of external provision
requirement: Verification including source inspection, test report validation, and customer verification at provider

title: Information for external providers
requirement: Flow-down of requirements: key characteristics, test specs, right of access, records retention, counterfeit prevention, ethics

title: Production control - FOD
requirement: Prevention, detection and removal of foreign objects (FOD); control of tooling, critical items and environment

title: Equipment, tools and software programs
requirement: Validate and control production equipment, tools and NC programs; storage and periodic inspection

title: Special processes
requirement: Validate special processes: qualified equipment and people, approved methods, records, revalidation

title: Production process verification (FAI)
requirement: First article inspection per AS9102 on the first production run and after changes
evidence: FAI done on new parts, not after process changes

title: Identification and traceability
requirement: Traceability through product life: lot/serial, as-built configuration, records

title: Preservation
requirement: Includes FOD prevention, shelf-life control, hazardous material handling, special handling

title: Post-delivery activities
requirement: Collect and analyse in-service data; technical documentation; repairs and maintenance

title: Control of changes
requirement: Persons authorized to approve production process changes; customer notification where required

title: Release of products
requirement: Authorized release, required documentation accompanies product, inspection and test records

title: Nonconforming outputs
requirement: MRB authority; customer approval for use-as-is or repair on customer designs; scrap made unusable; counterfeit or suspect parts controlled and reported

title: Customer satisfaction
requirement: Monitor conformity, on-time delivery, complaints and corrective action requests; improvement plans

title: Management review inputs
requirement: On-time delivery performance included

title: Corrective action
requirement: Flow corrective action to providers when they are responsible; human factors in root cause; act when actions are not timely or effective
